name: writer_uniqueness_violation
comment: writer-uniqueness violation: writer_id 'w1' binds on the first producer input; a delta_push from a DIFFERENT writer_id 'w2' is rejected (dropped, nothing appended) with SwmrDiagnostic{error, writer_conflict} -- the wire-level enforcement of writers=single (single-writer discipline). A subsequent read from w1's writer still shows only w1's content.
